source.page_or_item: Thirtieth annual report of the United States Civil Service Commission for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1915, printed page 121 as cited by WPA, PDF page 121

clauses.text:
January 5, 1915.
Fred W. Carrington may be promoted from assistant messenger in the Pension
Bureau to the clerical grade without examination under the civil-service rules.
This order is issued upon the recommendation of the Secretary of the Interior, in
recognition of an ingenious and public-spirited employee who has built and put into
operation a mechanical device and allowed the Government to take out patents for it.
